  model: 'claude-opus-4-5',
  max_tokens: 4096,
  messages: [{
    role: 'user',
    content: 'You are a CRM sales intelligence analyst for CRM Experts Online. Analyze this Zoho Bookings event and return ONLY valid JSON — no markdown, no backticks, no commentary.

BOOKING DATA:
Name: ' + $json.name + '
Email: ' + $json.email + '
Phone: ' + $json.phone + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '
Website: ' + $json.website + '
Booking ID: ' + $json.bookingId + '
Service: ' + $json.serviceName + '
Meeting Time: ' + $json.startTime + '
Notes/Subject: ' + ($json.subject || 'None') + '
Google Meet Link: ' + ($json.meetLink || 'None') + '
Trigger: ' + $json.trigger + '

SCORING RULES (start at 5):
+2 real company website and appears established
+2 tech/SaaS/CRM/ERP/services industry
+1 company appears to have 10+ employees
+1 international (non-US) booking
-1 personal email (gmail/yahoo/hotmail/outlook/icloud) with no company
-2 no website found
-3 spam or bot signals

CLASSIFICATION:
Prospect = business email matches company + CRM/ERP/sales inquiry service
Candidate = personal email + service is job/role/hiring related
Existing Client = company or email matches known CRM Experts account
Partner/Vendor = tech company, agency, reseller, or software vendor
Unknown = insufficient data to classify
Spam = fake company, disposable email, no website, incoherent data

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "classification": "Prospect|Candidate|Existing Client|Partner/Vendor|Unknown|Spam",
  "score": 7,
  "executiveSummary": "2-3 sentences: who are they, what do they do, why did they book, is this call worth taking?",
  "companyDescription": "1-2 sentences about the company based on domain/name/context",
  "companyIndustry": "industry",
  "companySize": "estimated headcount or Unknown",
  "personRole": "estimated role or Unknown",
  "whyBooked": "1-2 sentences connecting their service choice + company type + any signals",
  "callRecommendation": "YES|MAYBE|NO",
  "callReason": "1-2 sentence justification",
  "meetingPriority": "HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW",
  "priorityRationale": "brief rationale",
  "redFlags": ["flag 1", "flag 2"],
  "nextActions": ["1. Specific action", "2. Specific action", "3. Specific action"],
  "classificationConfidence": "HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW",
  "confidenceNotes": "what is confirmed vs inferred",
  "emailSubject": "New Booking: NAME | COMPANY | Score: X/10 | CLASSIFICATION",
  "emailHTML": "COMPLETE HTML EMAIL — see style requirements below"
}

For emailHTML generate a COMPLETE standalone HTML email with inline CSS only. Include:
- Full <html><head><body> structure
- Dark header bar (#1a1a2e) white text 24px: New Booking Alert
- Subheader with booking ID and timestamp
- Color-coded classification badge: Prospect=green(#27ae60), Partner/Vendor=blue(#2980b9), Candidate=orange(#e67e22), Spam=red(#c0392b), Unknown=gray(#7f8c8d), Existing Client=purple(#8e44ad)
- Score badge: 8-10=green, 5-7=orange, 1-4=red background
- Section 1: Executive Summary
- Section 2: Classification + Score (badges)
- Section 3: Contact Details table (Name/Email/Phone/Company/Website/Booking ID/Service/Meeting Time/Google Meet Link rows)
- Section 4: Company Intelligence (description/industry/size/role)
- Section 5: Why They Likely Booked
- Section 6: Call Recommendation (YES/MAYBE/NO with color) + reason
- Section 7: Meeting Priority (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) + rationale
- Section 8: Red Flags (bullet list or None identified)
- Section 9: Recommended Next Actions (numbered)
- Section 10: Confidence Assessment
- Section 11: Footer with: Booking Key: KEY | Trigger: TRIGGER | Processed: TIMESTAMP | Meet Link Added: YES/NO | Apollo API: Not configured — add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and APOLLO_API_KEY to n8n credentials | Automated by: Zoho Bookings Intelligence Monitor (n8n)
- Use max-width 680px centered layout, white card on light gray background, clean sans-serif font'
  }]
}) }}
